subject: general
question: In a certain code language, “ISLAND” is written as “SIALDN”, and “LAWYER” is written as “ALYWRE”. How will “LAUNCH” be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed by the given codes is:

 
• **The first and second alphabets are interchanged.**
 
• **The third and fourth alphabets are interchanged.**
 
• **The fifth and sixth alphabets are interchanged.**
